text:
[NMET.10.2.1] One event surfaces as both a metric and an
operational-log entry: a sample callback that returns non-OK
increments `ds.samples.dropped_total{reason="cb_error"}`, and
the engine emits a `DS_LOG_WARNING` `ds_log_event_t` in
category `samples` through the registered log callback. The
metric is the rate signal; the log carries the detail.
